clantag.commands_value:
`c!clantag role @role` — Configure role
`c!clantag channel #channel` — Join channel
`c!clantag removechannel #channel` — Removal channel
`c!clantag removenotify` — Toggle removals
`c!clantag list` — View users
`c!clantag embed` — Customize embeds
`c!clantag reset` — Delete everything
clantag.default_add_description: {user} now has the **{tag}** tag and received {role}
clantag.editor_description:
Customize notification messages.

**Variables:** `{user}`, `{role}`, `{tag}`, `{server}`
**Formatting:** `**bold**`, `*italic*`, `__underline__`
**Server emojis:** type `:name:` and Copy converts it automatically.
